summary: OpenAI published a customer case study describing how travel platform Omio integrated ChatGPT and Codex into its customer-facing conversational travel experience and internal engineering workflows.

categories.reason: The document describes a booking/transportation marketplace reporting internal efficiency gains and a new conversational commerce interface from adopting OpenAI tools, though this is a single self-reported case study.
categories.quote: Omio estimates that many products can now be built in roughly 20% of the time previously required.
